description: This file is a shell script (.sh) used for testing notes merging and conflict resolution in a version control system, likely Git. It sets up various scenarios involving commits, notes, and merges, including conflict detection, conflict resolution, and merge finalization.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies the notes in a specified reference against expected output, checking the notes' content and log.

methods.name: notes_merge_files_gone
methods.description: Checks if all NOTES_MERGE_* files in the .git directory are gone, indicating the merge state has been cleaned up.
